title: THE RAID DIRECTOR
why: His yes to the Raid Director: pressure should rise and fall. The waves used to come on a clock, every ten to twenty-two seconds whatever was happening. Now the game reads how the raid is going. Lose a lot of health, or have machines on you, and the raid goes into a breather: no new pack for fourteen to twenty-four seconds and until things calm down, so you can heal and reload. Stay quiet and the waves come sooner, up to a pace sixty percent faster. After a long quiet stretch, two minutes into the raid, the next wave is an ambush: two machines more than a normal pack, landing just off screen on the side you are facing away from, called WAVE with AMBUSH BEHIND YOU. No ambush while you stand near an extraction ring, and no pack ever lands within the ring of an extraction point. DEMO and CAREER do the same.
now: The waves now rise and fall with how the raid is going: a breather after a hard hit, an ambush from behind after a long quiet.
